title: Rabbi Abba HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 15b, where he said to Rabbi Yose HaKohen: "Why did Rabbi Yochanan stay silent and not answer Resh Lakish?" And in Jerusalem Talmud Shevi'it ch. 5, halakhah 1, this statement is in the name of Rabbi Bun bar Kahana. He is also mentioned in Ta'anit 13a, where he said in the name of Rabbi Yose HaKohen: an incident occurred and the sons of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina died. It is very far-fetched to say that Rabbi Yose HaKohen is Rabbi Assi, the colleague of Rabbi Ami, as is the opinion of Mishpachot Soferim.

notes.text: Hyman strongly rejects identifying Yose HaKohen with Assi; that negation and the deaths of Yose son of Chanina’s sons are preserved.
